blind.description: A freestanding circular stone basin or font. It features a wide bowl with a thick segmented stone rim adorned with polished bronze studs around its perimeter, supported by a fluted pedestal standing on a molded circular base. The interior holds a dark grey liquid or deep bowl interior. Surfaces are completely solid, smooth, and well-modeled with clean stylized textures.
blind.from_above: Concentric circles formed by the outer segmented stone rim studded with small bronze spheres, framing a deep, smooth dark basin.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the scale figure (roughly 2.5 to 3 feet tall) and about 3.5 feet wide across the rim.
